text.feels_intro: How {name}'s abrasions from being dragged along the ground on a leash feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a reddened graze along the cheek, smeared with dirt from the ground.
{name}'s face: a long, gravelly abrasion along the cheek and jaw, weeping and swelling where it scraped the ground.
{name}'s face: the skin is scraped away in a raw, bleeding patch packed with grit, the cheek swollen and the eye beside it puffed half shut.
{name}'s face: the scrape has crusted over in dark scabs, the skin around it pink, tight and bruised yellow-green.
{name}'s face: a pink, shiny patch marks where the scrape was; only a little flaking remains.
{name}'s face: the scrape has healed, leaving a faint pale mark.
body: {name}'s back: dusty and rubbed pink in long streaks where it slid over the ground.
{name}'s back: long, raw abrasions streak the skin where {he} was hauled over the ground, grit caught in them.
{name}'s back: wide stretches of skin are scraped away in long bleeding tracks, packed with dirt and grit.
{name}'s back: the scrapes have scabbed in long dark lines over fading yellow-green bruises.
{name}'s back: faint pink streaks show where the scrapes were.
{name}'s back: the skin has healed smooth, with no mark left.
arm: {name}'s {part}: the elbow and forearm are reddened and rubbed raw in patches.
{name}'s {part}: the elbow is scraped and weeping, with a dark bruise spreading along the forearm.
{name}'s {part}: the elbow and forearm are skinned to the red flesh in long tracks, caked with grit and blood.
{name}'s {part}: scabs cover the elbow and forearm, ringed with fading yellow-green bruising.
{name}'s {part}: small pink patches mark the healed scrapes.
{name}'s {part}: the arm looks normal again, without a mark.
leg: {name}'s {part}: the knee is scuffed red and the shin rubbed raw in places.
{name}'s {part}: the knee and shin are scraped raw and weeping in long streaks from being dragged.
{name}'s {part}: the knee and shin are skinned in long bleeding tracks, dirt ground deep into the wounds.
{name}'s {part}: scabs cover the knee and shin over fading yellow-green bruises.
{name}'s {part}: pink patches and faint brown shadows mark where the scrapes were.
{name}'s {part}: the leg looks normal again, without a mark.

head: {name}'s cheek stings where it hit the dirt, and {his} head swims a little. {name} is startled and shaken, wiping at {his} face.
{name}'s face burns and throbs where the skin was scraped off, and {his} head aches from being hauled along. {name} is angry and humiliated, flinching from anything that touches it.
{name}'s face is a raw, burning agony full of grit, and {his} head spins from being hauled along. {name} is dazed, tearful and frightened, barely able to open the swollen eye.
{name}'s face is tight and itchy under the scabs. {name} is self-conscious and keeps from touching it.
{name}'s face is only a little tender. {name} is wary of hitting the ground again.
{name}'s face feels normal again, though {he} flinches at the thought of the dirt.
body: {name}'s back stings where it slid over the ground. {name} straightens up stiffly, brushing off dirt.
{name}'s back burns along the long scrapes from being dragged. {name} moves stiffly and winces when {he} twists.
{name}'s back is a raw, burning agony of torn skin and grit. {name} gasps, hunched and barely able to sit up.
{name}'s back is tight and itchy under the scabs. {name} avoids lying on it.
{name}'s back is only a little sore when pressed. {name} is wary of the leash going taut again.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings at the elbow. {name} rubs it, shaken.
{name}'s {part} burns at the scraped elbow and aches along the bruise. {name} keeps it close and uses it carefully.
{name}'s {part} is a raw, throbbing agony from elbow to wrist. {name} is in shock, clutching the arm and unable to put weight on it.
{name}'s {part} is tight and itchy under the scabs and stiff at the elbow. {name} favors the other arm.
{name}'s {part} is almost back to normal, sore only when pressed. {name} braces it without thinking when {he} stumbles.
{name}'s {part} has its full movement and strength again.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings along the shin. {name} walks with a slight hitch.
{name}'s {part} burns at the scraped knee and aches in the thigh. {name} limps and winces at every step.
{name}'s {part} is a raw, throbbing agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support to move.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and itchy under the scabs and sore after a little walking. {name} limps and rests it when {he} can.
{name}'s {part} is only a little stiff in the cold. {name} is careful on rough ground.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again.
